g.text: Retained raw-cell domain; source is external cells/simulator.

g.desc: Main-current connector/fuse and pack construction remain TBD.

g.text: 8.526V is a sizing case, not an accepted pack OV limit.

g.desc: 8.526V is a sizing case, not an accepted pack OV limit.

g.text: No bypass around DSG or future RBF. Hot/pulse/SOA open.

g.desc: No bypass around DSG or future RBF. Hot/pulse/SOA open.

g.text: Two independent103AT-2 NTCs; quiet raw returns, no MCU bypass.

g.desc: Two independent103AT-2 NTCs; quiet raw returns, no MCU bypass.

g.desc: TS1/TS2 cell mode; TS2 default FET mode must change; commissioning TBD.

g.desc: TI SLUSCS4C Fig9-13: common-drain CHG/DSG arrangement.

g.desc: No secondary fuse or PTC selected; permanent-failure policy TBD.

g.desc: TS3/4, PRES/DISP/PTC/PTCEN and display disabled in configuration.
